import cocotb
from cocotb.clock import Clock
from cocotb.triggers import ClockCycles, FallingEdge, RisingEdge, Timer


CLK_NS = 10
NUM_SRC = 8


async def start(dut):
    cocotb.start_soon(Clock(dut.PCLK, CLK_NS, "ns").start())
    dut.PSEL.value = 0
    dut.PENABLE.value = 0
    dut.PWRITE.value = 0
    dut.PADDR.value = 0
    dut.PWDATA.value = 0
    dut.irq_src.value = 0
    dut.PRESETn.value = 0
    await ClockCycles(dut.PCLK, 2)
    await FallingEdge(dut.PCLK)
    dut.PRESETn.value = 1
    await Timer(1, unit="ns")


def check_idle_response(dut):
    assert int(dut.PREADY.value) == 1
    assert int(dut.PRDATA.value) == 0
    assert int(dut.PSLVERR.value) == 0


async def apb_transfer(dut, addr, write=False, data=0):
    """Perform one APB transfer and return (read_data, slave_error)."""
    await FallingEdge(dut.PCLK)
    dut.PSEL.value = 1
    dut.PENABLE.value = 0
    dut.PWRITE.value = int(write)
    dut.PADDR.value = addr
    dut.PWDATA.value = data
    await Timer(1, unit="ns")
    check_idle_response(dut)

    await FallingEdge(dut.PCLK)
    dut.PENABLE.value = 1
    await Timer(1, unit="ns")
    assert int(dut.PREADY.value) == 1
    read_data = int(dut.PRDATA.value)
    error = int(dut.PSLVERR.value)
    if write:
        assert read_data == 0

    await RisingEdge(dut.PCLK)
    await FallingEdge(dut.PCLK)
    dut.PSEL.value = 0
    dut.PENABLE.value = 0
    dut.PWRITE.value = 0
    await Timer(1, unit="ns")
    check_idle_response(dut)
    return read_data, error


async def write_reg(dut, addr, data):
    _, error = await apb_transfer(dut, addr, True, data)
    return error


async def read_reg(dut, addr):
    data, error = await apb_transfer(dut, addr, False, 0)
    return data, error


async def wait_cycles(dut, count):
    await ClockCycles(dut.PCLK, count)
    await Timer(1, unit="ns")

async def register_map_and_apb_errors(dut):
    await start(dut)

    assert int(dut.PREADY.value) == 1
    assert int(dut.irq.value) == 0
    assert int(dut.irq_id.value) == 0

    reset_values = {
        0x00: 0,
        0x04: 0,
        0x08: 0,
        0x0C: 0,
        0x10: 0,
        0x14: 0,
        0x18: 0,
        0x1C: 0,
        0x20: 0,
        0x24: 0x1C0D0308,
        0x40: 0,
    }
    for addr, expected in reset_values.items():
        value, error = await read_reg(dut, addr)
        assert error == 0, f"unexpected error reading {addr:#x}"
        assert value == expected, f"bad reset value at {addr:#x}: {value:#x}"

    assert await write_reg(dut, 0x00, 0xFFFFFFFF) == 0
    assert (await read_reg(dut, 0x00))[0] == 1
    assert await write_reg(dut, 0x04, 0xFFFFFFFF) == 0
    assert (await read_reg(dut, 0x04))[0] == 0xFF
    assert await write_reg(dut, 0x08, 0xA5) == 0
    assert (await read_reg(dut, 0x08))[0] == 0xA5
    assert await write_reg(dut, 0x14, 0xFFFFFFFF) == 0
    assert (await read_reg(dut, 0x14))[0] == 7

    assert await write_reg(dut, 0x40, 0xFEDCBA98) == 0

    assert value == 2
    assert (await read_reg(dut, 0x1C))[0] == 0x02
    assert (await read_reg(dut, 0x0C))[0] == 0x05

    assert await write_reg(dut, 0x18, 2) == 0

    assert (await read_reg(dut, 0x0C))[0] == 0x05
    assert int(dut.irq_id.value) == 3

    assert (await read_reg(dut, 0x1C))[0] == 0x04
    assert int(dut.irq_id.value) == 1
    assert (await read_reg(dut, 0x18))[0] == 1

    assert (await read_reg(dut, 0x1C))[0] == 0x04

    assert int(dut.irq.value) == 0  # The remaining source is still in service.
    assert await write_reg(dut, 0x18, 3) == 0

    assert int(dut.irq_id.value) == 3

    dut.irq_src.value = 0
    await wait_cycles(dut, 5)

    assert (await read_reg(dut, 0x1C))[0] == 1
    await wait_cycles(dut, 4)

    assert int(dut.irq.value) == 0

    await FallingEdge(dut.PCLK)
    dut.irq_src.value = 0
    await wait_cycles(dut, 5)
    await FallingEdge(dut.PCLK)
    dut.irq_src.value = 1
    await wait_cycles(dut, 5)

    assert await write_reg(dut, 0x18, 1) == 0
    assert int(dut.irq.value) == 1
    assert int(dut.irq_id.value) == 1

    assert await write_reg(dut, 0x0C, 1) == 0

    assert (await read_reg(dut, 0x1C))[0] == 1

    # eligible immediately after completion.
    assert await write_reg(dut, 0x18, 1) == 0
    assert int(dut.irq.value) == 1
    assert int(dut.irq_id.value) == 1

    await FallingEdge(dut.PCLK)

        (0x04, 0),

import cocotb
from cocotb.clock import Clock
from cocotb.triggers import ClockCycles, FallingEdge, RisingEdge, Timer


CLK_NS = 10


async def start(dut):
    cocotb.start_soon(Clock(dut.PCLK, CLK_NS, "ns").start())
    dut.PSEL.value = 0
    dut.PENABLE.value = 0
    dut.PWRITE.value = 0
    dut.PADDR.value = 0
    dut.PWDATA.value = 0
    dut.irq_src.value = 0
    dut.PRESETn.value = 0
    await ClockCycles(dut.PCLK, 2)
    await FallingEdge(dut.PCLK)
    dut.PRESETn.value = 1
    await Timer(1, unit="ns")


async def apb_transfer(dut, addr, write, data=0, setup_addr=None):
    """Perform one APB transfer; return (PRDATA, PSLVERR) sampled in access."""
    await FallingEdge(dut.PCLK)
    dut.PSEL.value = 1
    dut.PENABLE.value = 0
    dut.PWRITE.value = int(write)
    dut.PADDR.value = addr if setup_addr is None else setup_addr
    dut.PWDATA.value = data
    await Timer(1, unit="ns")
    assert int(dut.PREADY.value) == 1
    assert int(dut.PRDATA.value) == 0
    assert int(dut.PSLVERR.value) == 0

    await FallingEdge(dut.PCLK)
    dut.PENABLE.value = 1
    dut.PADDR.value = addr
    await Timer(1, unit="ns")
    assert int(dut.PREADY.value) == 1
    value = int(dut.PRDATA.value)
    error = int(dut.PSLVERR.value)

    await RisingEdge(dut.PCLK)
    await FallingEdge(dut.PCLK)
    dut.PSEL.value = 0
    dut.PENABLE.value = 0
    dut.PWRITE.value = 0
    await Timer(1, unit="ns")
    assert int(dut.PREADY.value) == 1
    assert int(dut.PRDATA.value) == 0
    assert int(dut.PSLVERR.value) == 0
    return value, error


async def write_reg(dut, addr, data, error=0, setup_addr=None):
    value, got_error = await apb_transfer(
        dut, addr, True, data, setup_addr=setup_addr
    )
    assert value == 0
    assert got_error == error


async def read_reg(dut, addr, expected=None, error=0, setup_addr=None):
    value, got_error = await apb_transfer(
        dut, addr, False, 0, setup_addr=setup_addr
    )
    assert got_error == error
    if expected is not None:

        )
    return value


async def check_irq(dut, expected_id):
    await Timer(1, unit="ns")
    got_irq = int(dut.irq.value)
    got_id = int(dut.irq_id.value)
    assert got_irq == int(expected_id != 0)

        await Timer(1, unit="ns")

    await read_reg(dut, 0x08, 0)
    await read_reg(dut, 0x0C, 0)

from cocotb.triggers import ClockCycles, FallingEdge, RisingEdge, Timer

CLK_NS = 10
NUM_SRC = 8
ID_MASK = 0xFF


async def start(dut):
    cocotb.start_soon(Clock(dut.PCLK, CLK_NS, "ns").start())
    dut.PSEL.value = 0
    dut.PENABLE.value = 0
    dut.PWRITE.value = 0
    dut.PADDR.value = 0
    dut.PWDATA.value = 0
    dut.irq_src.value = 0
    dut.PRESETn.value = 0
    await ClockCycles(dut.PCLK, 2)
    await FallingEdge(dut.PCLK)
    dut.PRESETn.value = 1


async def apb_read(dut, addr, expected_error=0):
    await FallingEdge(dut.PCLK)
    dut.PSEL.value = 1
    dut.PENABLE.value = 0
    dut.PWRITE.value = 0
    dut.PADDR.value = addr
    dut.PWDATA.value = 0
    await Timer(1, unit="ns")
    assert int(dut.PREADY.value) == 1
    assert int(dut.PRDATA.value) == 0
    assert int(dut.PSLVERR.value) == 0

    await FallingEdge(dut.PCLK)
    dut.PENABLE.value = 1
    await Timer(1, unit="ns")
    assert int(dut.PREADY.value) == 1
    value = int(dut.PRDATA.value)
    error = int(dut.PSLVERR.value)
    assert error == expected_error, f"read {addr:#x}: PSLVERR={error}"
    if error:
        assert value == 0, f"erroring read {addr:#x} returned {value:#x}"

    await RisingEdge(dut.PCLK)
    await Timer(1, unit="ns")
    dut.PSEL.value = 0
    dut.PENABLE.value = 0
    dut.PWRITE.value = 0
    return value


async def apb_write(dut, addr, data):
    await FallingEdge(dut.PCLK)
    dut.PSEL.value = 1
    dut.PENABLE.value = 0
    dut.PWRITE.value = 1
    dut.PADDR.value = addr
    dut.PWDATA.value = data
    await Timer(1, unit="ns")
    assert int(dut.PREADY.value) == 1
    assert int(dut.PRDATA.value) == 0
    assert int(dut.PSLVERR.value) == 0

    await FallingEdge(dut.PCLK)
    dut.PENABLE.value = 1
    await Timer(1, unit="ns")
    assert int(dut.PREADY.value) == 1
    assert int(dut.PRDATA.value) == 0

    await RisingEdge(dut.PCLK)
    await Timer(1, unit="ns")
    dut.PSEL.value = 0
    dut.PENABLE.value = 0
    dut.PWRITE.value = 0


async def check_irq(dut, expected_irq, expected_id):
    assert int(dut.irq.value) == expected_irq
    assert int(dut.irq_id.value) == expected_id
    status = await apb_read(dut, 0x20)
    assert status & 1 == expected_irq
    assert (status >> 8) & ID_MASK == expected_id

    await FallingEdge(dut.PCLK)

    dut.PSEL.value = 0
    dut.PENABLE.value = 0

    dut.PADDR.value = 0
    dut.PWDATA.value = 0

from cocotb.triggers import ClockCycles, FallingEdge, RisingEdge, Timer

CLK_NS = 10


async def start(dut):
    cocotb.start_soon(Clock(dut.PCLK, CLK_NS, "ns").start())
    dut.PWRITE.value = 0
    dut.PWDATA.value = 0
    dut.PADDR.value = 0
    dut.PENABLE.value = 0
    dut.PSEL.value = 0
    dut.pwm_fault.value = 0
    dut.PRESETn.value = 0
    await ClockCycles(dut.PCLK, 2)
    await FallingEdge(dut.PCLK)
    dut.PRESETn.value = 1
    await Timer(1, unit="ns")


async def apb_write(dut, addr, data):
    await FallingEdge(dut.PCLK)
    dut.PSEL.value = 1
    dut.PENABLE.value = 0
    dut.PWRITE.value = 1
    dut.PADDR.value = addr
    dut.PWDATA.value = data
    await FallingEdge(dut.PCLK)
    dut.PENABLE.value = 1
    await RisingEdge(dut.PCLK)
    await FallingEdge(dut.PCLK)
    dut.PSEL.value = 0
    dut.PENABLE.value = 0
    dut.PWRITE.value = 0


async def read_now(dut, addr):
    dut.PADDR.value = addr
    await Timer(1, unit="ns")
    return int(dut.PRDATA.value)


async def timer_sample(dut):
    dut.PADDR.value = 0x0000
    await RisingEdge(dut.PCLK)
    await Timer(1, unit="ns")
    return int(dut.PRDATA.value)


@cocotb.test()
async def register_map_and_apb(dut):
    await start(dut)

    assert int(dut.PREADY.value) == 1

    reset_regs = [
        (0x0000, 0),
        (0x0004, 0),
        (0x0008, 0),
        (0x000C, 0),
        (0x0010, 0),
        (0x0014, 0),
        (0x0018, 0),
        (0x001C, 0),
        (0x0020, 0),
        (0x0024, 0),
        (0x0028, 0),
        (0xFF00, 0),
        (0xFF04, 0),
        (0xFF08, 0),
        (0xFF10, 0),
    ]
    for addr, expected in reset_regs:
        assert await read_now(dut, addr) == expected, f"reset value at {addr:#06x}"

    for addr in (0x002C, 0xFF0C, 0xFEFC, 0x0100):
        assert await read_now(dut, addr) == 0xDEADBEEF, f"unmapped/read-only address {addr:#06x}"

    values = [
        (0x0004, 0x89ABCDEF, 0x89ABCDEF),
        (0x0008, 0x12345678, 0x5678),
        (0x000C, 0x13579BDF, 0x13579BDF),
        (0x0010, 0x2468ACE0, 0x2468ACE0),
        (0x0014, 0xFFFFFFD5, 0x55),
        (0x0018, 0xFFFFFFFD, 0x5),
        (0x001C, 0xABCDEF12, 0xF12),
        (0x0020, 0xFEDCBA98, 0xBA98),
        (0x0024, 0x123456AB, 0xAB),
        (0x0028, 0x1234A539, 0xA539),
        (0xFF00, 0xFFFFFFFF, 0x7),
        (0xFF10, 0xFFFFFFFF, 0x1),
    ]
    for addr, data, expected in values:
        await apb_write(dut, addr, data)
        assert await read_now(dut, addr) == expected, f"stored value at {addr:#06x}"

    # The address decoder uses only the low 16 bits.
    assert await read_now(dut, 0x12340004) == 0x89ABCDEF
    assert await read_now(dut, 0xABCDFF10) == 1

    # TMR, MIS, and RIS are read-only; IC is write-only.
    await apb_write(dut, 0x0000, 0xFFFFFFFF)
    await apb_write(dut, 0xFF04, 7)
    await apb_write(dut, 0xFF08, 7)
    assert await read_now(dut, 0x0000) == 0
    assert await read_now(dut, 0xFF04) == 0
    assert await read_now(dut, 0xFF08) == 0
    assert await read_now(dut, 0xFF0C) == 0xDEADBEEF

    await apb_write(dut, 0x1234, 0xFFFFFFFF)
    assert await read_now(dut, 0x1234) == 0xDEADBEEF
    assert int(dut.PREADY.value) == 1


@cocotb.test()
async def up_count_periodic_and_prescaler(dut):
    await start(dut)
    await apb_write(dut, 0x0004, 7)
    await apb_write(dut, 0x0008, 0)
    await apb_write(dut, 0x0018, 6)  # up, periodic
    await apb_write(dut, 0x0014, 1)  # enable

    # Allow the TE edge detector and start sequence to settle. With PR=0,
    # every following clock is a tick.
    await ClockCycles(dut.PCLK, 6)
    value = await read_now(dut, 0x0000)
    for _ in range(24):
        if value == 7:
            expected = 0
        else:
            expected = value + 1
        value = await timer_sample(dut)
        assert value == expected, f"up-count recurrence: expected {expected}, got {value}"

    # Stop the timer and check that the count holds while TE is low.
    await apb_write(dut, 0x0014, 0)
    held = await read_now(dut, 0x0000)
    await ClockCycles(dut.PCLK, 5)
    assert await read_now(dut, 0x0000) == held

    # A nonzero prescaler gives one count transition every PR+1 clocks.
    await apb_write(dut, 0x0004, 100)
    await apb_write(dut, 0x0008, 2)
    await apb_write(dut, 0x0018, 6)
    await apb_write(dut, 0x0014, 1)
    await ClockCycles(dut.PCLK, 10)
    samples = []
    for _ in range(42):
        samples.append(await timer_sample(dut))

    transitions = []
    for index in range(1, len(samples)):
        if samples[index] != samples[index - 1]:
            assert samples[index] == samples[index - 1] + 1
            transitions.append(index)
    assert len(transitions) >= 8
    for left, right in zip(transitions, transitions[1:]):
        assert right - left == 3, f"prescaled transition interval was {right - left}"

import random

import cocotb
from cocotb.clock import Clock
from cocotb.triggers import ClockCycles, FallingEdge, RisingEdge, Timer


CLK_NS = 10
NUM_SRC = 8
PRIO_BITS = 3
MASK = (1 << NUM_SRC) - 1


class Reference:
    def __init__(self):
        self.ctrl = 0
        self.enable = 0
        self.trigger = 0
        self.threshold = 0
        self.priorities = [0] * NUM_SRC
        self.pending = 0
        self.inservice = 0
        self.sync1 = 0
        self.sync2 = 0
        self.sync_prev = 0

    def reset(self):
        self.ctrl = 0
        self.enable = 0
        self.trigger = 0
        self.threshold = 0
        self.priorities = [0] * NUM_SRC
        self.pending = 0
        self.inservice = 0
        self.sync1 = 0
        self.sync2 = 0
        self.sync_prev = 0

    def selected(self):
        candidates = []
        for source in range(NUM_SRC):
            priority = self.priorities[source]
            if (
                (self.pending >> source) & 1
                and (self.enable >> source) & 1
                and not ((self.inservice >> source) & 1)
                and priority != 0
            ):
                candidates.append((priority, source))
        if not candidates:
            return 0
        priority, source = max(candidates, key=lambda item: (item[0], -item[1]))
        if (self.ctrl & 1) and priority > self.threshold:
            return source + 1
        return 0

    def mapped(self, address):
        if address & 3:
            return False
        if address in (0x00, 0x04, 0x08, 0x0C, 0x10, 0x14, 0x18, 0x1C, 0x20, 0x24):
            return True
        if 0x40 <= address < 0x40 + 4 * ((NUM_SRC + 7) // 8):
            return True
        return False

    def read_value(self, address):
        if address == 0x00:
            return self.ctrl
        if address == 0x04:
            return self.enable
        if address == 0x08:
            return self.trigger
        if address == 0x0C:
            return self.pending
        if address == 0x10:
            return 0
        if address == 0x14:
            return self.threshold
        if address == 0x18:
            return self.selected()
        if address == 0x1C:
            return self.inservice
        if address == 0x20:
            selected = self.selected()

import cocotb
from cocotb.clock import Clock
from cocotb.triggers import ClockCycles, FallingEdge, ReadOnly, RisingEdge

CLK_NS = 10

RXDATA = 0x0000
TXDATA = 0x0004
PR = 0x0008
CTRL = 0x000C
CFG = 0x0010
MATCH = 0x001C
RX_LEVEL = 0xFE00
RX_THRESHOLD = 0xFE04
RX_FLUSH = 0xFE08
TX_LEVEL = 0xFE10
TX_THRESHOLD = 0xFE14
TX_FLUSH = 0xFE18
IM = 0xFF00
MIS = 0xFF04
RIS = 0xFF08
IC = 0xFF0C
GCLK = 0xFF10


async def start(dut):
    """Start the clock, initialize the bus and UART input, and release reset."""
    cocotb.start_soon(Clock(dut.PCLK, CLK_NS, "ns").start())
    dut.PWRITE.value = 0
    dut.PWDATA.value = 0
    dut.PADDR.value = 0
    dut.PENABLE.value = 0
    dut.PSEL.value = 0
    dut.rx.value = 1
    dut.PRESETn.value = 0
    await ClockCycles(dut.PCLK, 2)
    await FallingEdge(dut.PCLK)
    dut.PRESETn.value = 1
    await ClockCycles(dut.PCLK, 2)


async def apb_write(dut, addr, data):
    """Perform one APB write transfer."""
    await FallingEdge(dut.PCLK)
    dut.PSEL.value = 1
    dut.PENABLE.value = 0
    dut.PWRITE.value = 1
    dut.PADDR.value = addr
    dut.PWDATA.value = data
    await FallingEdge(dut.PCLK)
    dut.PENABLE.value = 1
    await RisingEdge(dut.PCLK)
    await FallingEdge(dut.PCLK)
    dut.PSEL.value = 0
    dut.PENABLE.value = 0
    dut.PWRITE.value = 0


async def apb_read(dut, addr):
    """Perform one APB read transfer and return its access-cycle data."""
    await FallingEdge(dut.PCLK)
    dut.PSEL.value = 1
    dut.PENABLE.value = 0
    dut.PWRITE.value = 0
    dut.PADDR.value = addr
    await FallingEdge(dut.PCLK)
    dut.PENABLE.value = 1
    await ReadOnly()
    value = int(dut.PRDATA.value)
    await RisingEdge(dut.PCLK)
    await FallingEdge(dut.PCLK)
    dut.PSEL.value = 0
    dut.PENABLE.value = 0
    return value


async def send_uart_frame(dut, value, width=8):
    """Drive one no-parity, one-stop-bit UART frame at the default SC=8."""
    await FallingEdge(dut.PCLK)
    dut.rx.value = 0
    await ClockCycles(dut.PCLK, 8)
    for bit_index in range(width):
        await FallingEdge(dut.PCLK)
        dut.rx.value = (value >> bit_index) & 1
        await ClockCycles(dut.PCLK, 8)
    await FallingEdge(dut.PCLK)
    dut.rx.value = 1
    await ClockCycles(dut.PCLK, 8)

async def tx_fifo_full_flush_and_interrupts(dut):
    await start(dut)

    # Keep the transmitter from advancing while filling the FIFO.
    await apb_write(dut, CTRL, 0)
    for index in range(16):
        await apb_write(dut, TXDATA, 0x100 + index)

    # The four-bit level wraps to zero at full.
    assert await apb_read(dut, TX_LEVEL) == 0

    # An additional write to a full FIFO is ignored.
    await apb_write(dut, TXDATA, 0x1AA)
    assert await apb_read(dut, TX_LEVEL) == 0

    await apb_write(dut, TX_FLUSH, 1)
    await ClockCycles(dut.PCLK, 3)
    assert await apb_read(dut, TX_LEVEL) == 0

    # A non-full FIFO reports its actual level and TXE/TXB conditions are
    # reflected in the sticky raw status and masked interrupt output.
    await apb_write(dut, TXDATA, 0x55)
    assert await apb_read(dut, TX_LEVEL) == 1

    await apb_write(dut, IM, 1)
    await ClockCycles(dut.PCLK, 2)
    assert (await apb_read(dut, RIS) & 1) != 0
    assert (await apb_read(dut, MIS) & 1) != 0
    assert int(dut.IRQ.value) == 1

    # Clear TXE while the FIFO is nonempty, so its set condition is absent.
    await apb_write(dut, IC, 1)
    await ClockCycles(dut.PCLK, 2)
    assert (await apb_read(dut, RIS) & 1) == 0
    assert int(dut.IRQ.value) == 0

    # TXB sets when the FIFO level is below its threshold.
    await apb_write(dut, TX_THRESHOLD, 2)
    await ClockCycles(dut.PCLK, 2)
    assert (await apb_read(dut, RIS) & (1 << 2)) != 0

    # Remove the TXB condition and clear its sticky status.
    await apb_write(dut, TX_THRESHOLD, 0)
    await apb_write(dut, IC, 1 << 2)
    await ClockCycles(dut.PCLK, 2)
    assert (await apb_read(dut, RIS) & (1 << 2)) == 0

    dut.PWRITE.value = 0
    dut.PADDR.value = addr
    await FallingEdge(dut.PCLK)
    dut.PENABLE.value = 1

    await FallingEdge(dut.PCLK)

from cocotb.triggers import ClockCycles, FallingEdge, ReadOnly, RisingEdge

CLK_NS = 10

    cocotb.start_soon(Clock(dut.PCLK, CLK_NS, "ns").start())
    dut.PWRITE.value = 0
    dut.PWDATA.value = 0
    dut.PADDR.value = 0
    dut.PENABLE.value = 0
    dut.PSEL.value = 0
    dut.rx.value = 1
    dut.PRESETn.value = 0
    await ClockCycles(dut.PCLK, 2)
    await FallingEdge(dut.PCLK)
    dut.PRESETn.value = 1
    await ClockCycles(dut.PCLK, 1)


async def apb_write(dut, addr, data):
    await FallingEdge(dut.PCLK)
    dut.PSEL.value, dut.PENABLE.value, dut.PWRITE.value = 1, 0, 1
    dut.PADDR.value, dut.PWDATA.value = addr, data
    await FallingEdge(dut.PCLK)
    dut.PENABLE.value = 1
    await RisingEdge(dut.PCLK)
    await FallingEdge(dut.PCLK)
    dut.PSEL.value, dut.PENABLE.value, dut.PWRITE.value = 0, 0, 0


async def apb_read(dut, addr):
    await FallingEdge(dut.PCLK)
    dut.PSEL.value, dut.PENABLE.value, dut.PWRITE.value = 1, 0, 0
    dut.PADDR.value = addr
    await FallingEdge(dut.PCLK)
    dut.PENABLE.value = 1
    await ReadOnly()
    value = int(dut.PRDATA.value)
    await RisingEdge(dut.PCLK)
    await FallingEdge(dut.PCLK)
    dut.PSEL.value, dut.PENABLE.value = 0, 0
    return value


async def send_frame(dut, value, width=8, parity=None, stop_bits=1):
    """Drive one UART frame with eight clocks per bit; parity is None or 0/1."""
    bits = [0]
    bits.extend((value >> bit) & 1 for bit in range(width))
    if parity is not None:
        bits.append(parity)
    bits.extend([1] * stop_bits)
    for bit in bits:
        await FallingEdge(dut.PCLK)
        dut.rx.value = bit
        await ClockCycles(dut.PCLK, 8)
    await FallingEdge(dut.PCLK)
    dut.rx.value = 1
    await ClockCycles(dut.PCLK, 20)

import cocotb
from cocotb.clock import Clock
from cocotb.triggers import ClockCycles, FallingEdge, ReadOnly, RisingEdge

CLK_NS = 10

RXDATA = 0x0000
TXDATA = 0x0004
PR = 0x0008
CTRL = 0x000C
CFG = 0x0010
MATCH = 0x001C
RX_LEVEL = 0xFE00
RX_THRESHOLD = 0xFE04
RX_FLUSH = 0xFE08
TX_LEVEL = 0xFE10
TX_THRESHOLD = 0xFE14
TX_FLUSH = 0xFE18
IM = 0xFF00
MIS = 0xFF04
RIS = 0xFF08
IC = 0xFF0C
GCLK = 0xFF10


async def start_clock(dut):
    cocotb.start_soon(Clock(dut.PCLK, CLK_NS, "ns").start())
    dut.PWRITE.value = 0
    dut.PWDATA.value = 0
    dut.PADDR.value = 0
    dut.PENABLE.value = 0
    dut.PSEL.value = 0
    dut.rx.value = 1
    dut.PRESETn.value = 0
    await ClockCycles(dut.PCLK, 3)
    await FallingEdge(dut.PCLK)
    dut.PRESETn.value = 1
    await ClockCycles(dut.PCLK, 3)


async def reset_dut(dut):
    await FallingEdge(dut.PCLK)
    dut.PRESETn.value = 0
    dut.PSEL.value = 0
    dut.PENABLE.value = 0
    dut.PWRITE.value = 0
    dut.rx.value = 1
    await ClockCycles(dut.PCLK, 3)
    await FallingEdge(dut.PCLK)
    dut.PRESETn.value = 1
    await ClockCycles(dut.PCLK, 4)


async def apb_write(dut, addr, data):
    await FallingEdge(dut.PCLK)
    dut.PSEL.value = 1
    dut.PENABLE.value = 0
    dut.PWRITE.value = 1
    dut.PADDR.value = addr
    dut.PWDATA.value = data
    await FallingEdge(dut.PCLK)
    dut.PENABLE.value = 1
    await RisingEdge(dut.PCLK)
    await FallingEdge(dut.PCLK)
    dut.PSEL.value = 0
    dut.PENABLE.value = 0
    dut.PWRITE.value = 0


async def apb_read(dut, addr):
    await FallingEdge(dut.PCLK)
    dut.PSEL.value = 1
    dut.PENABLE.value = 0
    dut.PWRITE.value = 0
    dut.PADDR.value = addr
    await FallingEdge(dut.PCLK)
    dut.PENABLE.value = 1
    await ReadOnly()
    value = int(dut.PRDATA.value)
    await RisingEdge(dut.PCLK)
    await FallingEdge(dut.PCLK)
    dut.PSEL.value = 0
    dut.PENABLE.value = 0
    return value


async def send_frame(dut, value, parity=None, stops=(1,)):
    """Drive an 8-bit UART frame with the default SC=8 timing."""
    bits = [0]
    bits.extend((value >> bit) & 1 for bit in range(8))
    if parity is not None:
        bits.append(parity)
    bits.extend(stops)
    for bit in bits:
        await FallingEdge(dut.PCLK)
        dut.rx.value = bit
        await ClockCycles(dut.PCLK, 8)
    await FallingEdge(dut.PCLK)
    dut.rx.value = 1
    await ClockCycles(dut.PCLK, 4)

async def uart_apb_suite(dut):
    await start_clock(dut)

    assert int(dut.PREADY.value) == 1
    assert int(dut.tx.value) == 1

    # Reset values, address decode, and basic register access.
    assert await apb_read(CFG) == 0x3F08
    assert await apb_read(PR) == 0
    assert await apb_read(CTRL) == 0
    assert await apb_read(MATCH) == 0
    assert await apb_read(RX_THRESHOLD) == 0
    assert await apb_read(TX_THRESHOLD) == 0
    assert await apb_read(IM) == 0
    assert await apb_read(GCLK) == 0
    assert await apb_read(TXDATA) == 0xDEADBEEF
    assert await apb_read(IC) == 0xDEADBEEF
    assert await apb_read(0x1234) == 0xDEADBEEF

    await apb_write(dut, 0x10008, 0x1234)
    assert await apb_read(PR) == 0x1234
    await apb_write(dut, CFG, 0xFFFFFFFF)
    assert await apb_read(CFG) == 0x3FFF

    # Read-only registers ignore writes.
    await apb_write(dut, RX_LEVEL, 7)
    await apb_write(dut, TX_LEVEL, 7)
    assert await apb_read(RX_LEVEL) == 0
    assert await apb_read(TX_LEVEL) == 0

    await apb_write(dut, TX_THRESHOLD, 9)

    assert await apb_read(TX_THRESHOLD) == 9

TX_FLUSH = 0xFE18

    cocotb.start_soon(Clock(dut.PCLK, CLK_NS, "ns").start())
    dut.PWRITE.value = 0
    dut.PWDATA.value = 0
    dut.PADDR.value = 0
    dut.PENABLE.value = 0
    dut.PSEL.value = 0
    dut.rx.value = 1
    dut.PRESETn.value = 0
    await ClockCycles(dut.PCLK, 3)
    await FallingEdge(dut.PCLK)
    dut.PRESETn.value = 1
    await ClockCycles(dut.PCLK, 3)


async def reset_dut(dut):
    await FallingEdge(dut.PCLK)
    dut.PRESETn.value = 0
    dut.PSEL.value = 0
    dut.PENABLE.value = 0
    dut.PWRITE.value = 0
    dut.rx.value = 1
    await ClockCycles(dut.PCLK, 3)
    await FallingEdge(dut.PCLK)
    dut.PRESETn.value = 1
    await ClockCycles(dut.PCLK, 4)


async def apb_write(dut, addr, data):
    await FallingEdge(dut.PCLK)
    dut.PSEL.value = 1
    dut.PENABLE.value = 0
    dut.PWRITE.value = 1
    dut.PADDR.value = addr
    dut.PWDATA.value = data
    await FallingEdge(dut.PCLK)
    dut.PENABLE.value = 1
    await RisingEdge(dut.PCLK)
    await FallingEdge(dut.PCLK)
    dut.PSEL.value = 0
    dut.PENABLE.value = 0
    dut.PWRITE.value = 0


async def apb_read(dut, addr):
    await FallingEdge(dut.PCLK)
    dut.PSEL.value = 1
    dut.PENABLE.value = 0
    dut.PWRITE.value = 0
    dut.PADDR.value = addr
    await FallingEdge(dut.PCLK)
    dut.PENABLE.value = 1
    await ReadOnly()
    value = int(dut.PRDATA.value)
    await RisingEdge(dut.PCLK)
    await FallingEdge(dut.PCLK)
    dut.PSEL.value = 0
    dut.PENABLE.value = 0
    return value


async def send_frame(dut, value, parity=None, stops=(1,)):
    """Drive an 8-bit UART frame with the default SC=8 timing."""
    bits = [0]

    bits.extend(stops)

        await ClockCycles(dut.PCLK, 8)
    await FallingEdge(dut.PCLK)
    dut.rx.value = 1
    await ClockCycles(dut.PCLK, 4)
